text:
alex_g: FYI we just got verbal OK from Nova Therapeutics for a 4-week POC. They want to validate clinical-note summarization + latency/cost. Asking for DPA, SOC2 artifacts, and confirmation on pen-test rules. Also pricing for a short dedicated trial. can SRE/sec/solutions weigh in?

maria_se: awesome. quick clarifying q's: 1) POC goals (accuracy/latency/cost)? 2) data type: de-id vs PHI? 3) will they provide an eval set or want us to build one?

alex_g: Customer initial asks: - Accuracy: ~95% clinically accurate summary per their annotator set - Latency: <500ms p95 for single-doc summaries - Timeline: 4 weeks (2 wks de-id testing, 2 wks with live PHI under BA) - Need DPA + SOC2 Type II evidence and BAA for PHI stage - They asked whether external pen-test on infra is allowed

sara_soleng: I can own evals. plan: ingest their sample notes, create 200-item labeled eval set, run nightly evals + threshold gating. sample prompt we plan to use:```Summarize the clinical note focusing on diagnoses, active medications, and recommended follow-ups. Output JSON with fields: diagnosis[], meds[], follow_up```scoring: token-level F1 for entities + human spot check for clinical fidelity. acceptance: pass if >=95% entity F1 and no major clinical hallucinations in 95% of samples.

ken_platform: pricing/ops note: for a 4-week dedicated medium pool (~2xA100 equiv) rough baseline: $12k for 4 weeks (pay-as-you-go). We can offer a temporary POC discount: 50% off first month if they sign MSA => $6k. If they convert to a monthly reserved commit we can credit the POC. For PHI stage we recommend Dedicated or Private (VPC).

dylan_sec: Security bits: we can provide SOC2 Type II report summary and PCI/HIPAA attestation excerpts where applicable. For BAA: legal needs org/legal contact to sign. For PHI in POC: must run in Redwood Private or Dedicated with CMEK and audit logging enabled. External pentest: allowed only against customer-dedicated tenancy and requires a scope addendum + 2-week notice; we coordinate and require pen-test SOW. We'll not allow noisy scans against shared control plane.

maria_legal: I'll draft/send our DPA and BAA templates and attach the redacted SOC2 summary. Need customer legal contact + org address. Pen-test addendum: we require scope, allowed IPs, dates, and non-disclosure clauses; we also require proof of insurance from tester.

sara_soleng: attaching prompt examples for the eval set (paste here):
1) "Patient note: 65yo M with HTN, started lisinopril 10mg, presenting with cough..." -> expected JSON with diagnosis and meds
2) "ER note: chest pain, ECG negative, discharged with nitro PRN" -> expected summary + triage decision
3) "Psych consult: anxiety, insomnia, started CBT, no meds changed" -> expected concise summary
we'll automate scoring and keep a human review for borderline items.

ken_platform: ops followups: i) to enable PHI stage we need either Private deployment or Dedicated with KMS customer key ii) timeline to provision Dedicated test tenant ~3 business days once PO/commit received iii) pen-test coordination typically adds 2-3 weeks to timeline.

dylan_sec: PHI POC checklist: - Signed BAA in place - Deployment = Private or Dedicated with CMEK - Audit logging + 90d retention enabled - Pen-test scope agreed and scheduled if customer requests - Data retention & deletion plan documented

alex_g: action items / owners: sara_soleng -> build eval + sample prompts; ken_platform -> send POC pricing + provisioning steps; maria_legal -> send DPA/BAA + SOC2 summary; dylan_sec -> confirm pen-test process and checklist. target kickoff next Mon. @sara_soleng @ken_platform @maria_legal @dylan_sec please ack. :thumbsup:
sara_soleng: ack :thumbsup:
ken_platform: ack, will send draft pricing email today
maria_legal: ack, will DM templates and ask for customer legal contact
dylan_sec: ack, will prepare pen-test addendum template and checklist
alex_g: thanks all — i'll update the customer and loop them into the legal thread once i have the docs.
